# iOS MCP

An MCP server inside SpringBoard: an AI agent can take screenshots, read the accessibility tree and the live system log, tap, type, open apps and more — 46 tools.

Based on [witchan/ios-mcp](https://github.com/witchan/ios-mcp) 1.2.8, packaged for **shivtools** with safer defaults: it listens on **127.0.0.1 only**, `mcp-root` comes **without setuid**, and installing a deb through it **does not respring** on its own.

```
shiv-mcp durum          # installed, running, which mode
shiv-mcp baglan         # the claude mcp add line for this phone
shiv-mcp baglan --mac   # SSH tunnel + claude mcp add for a Mac
```

`shiv-mcp` comes with **shivtools**. Restart the CLI after adding the server.

The server has **no authentication**. By default it only accepts connections from the phone itself.

- `shiv-mcp mod ag` listens on the network — it asks first. Don't use it on public Wi-Fi.
- From a Mac, prefer the SSH tunnel: login and encryption come for free.
- `shiv-mcp root-ac` gives `mcp-root` its setuid bit. Only if you need root actions through the agent.
Respring once so SpringBoard loads the server. **Settings → iOS MCP** starts and stops it.

iOS MCP is MIT. The package also carries AppSync Unified and appinst (GPL-3.0) and ldid (AGPL-3.0), built unmodified from [witchan/ios-mcp v1.2.8](https://github.com/witchan/ios-mcp/tree/v1.2.8). Licence texts: `/usr/share/doc/`.
- Icon and depiction pages. The package contents are unchanged.

- Listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; network mode is a setting.
- `mcp-root` without setuid by default.
- Installing a deb no longer resprings by itself.
- Turkish interface.
- Everything included: server, OCR, IPA installer.
